name: Lite Maintenance Mode
author: Dharmendra Patidar

sections.description:
Lite Maintenance Mode allows you to quickly enable a professional “Coming Soon” or “Under Maintenance” page. With its new version 1.0.3, the plugin now features a premium-looking admin dashboard and expanded customization options.

Administrators can continue to browse the live site while visitors see a beautiful, responsive maintenance page.

Key Features:
* New Premium Admin UI: Modern, tab-based settings panel inspired by high-end design.
* Social Media Integration: Connect with your audience via Facebook, Instagram, Twitter, and WhatsApp.
* Favicon Support: Upload a custom favicon specifically for your maintenance page.
* SEO Friendly: Automatically sends a 503 Service Unavailable header to protect your search rankings.
* Full Customization: Control headings, subheadings, messages, and background/logo images.

Features

  • Modern sidebar navigation in the admin panel.
  • Toggle switch to enable/disable maintenance mode instantly.
  • Custom Favicon option for professional branding.
  • Social Media icons support (Facebook, Instagram, WhatsApp, Twitter).
  • Glassmorphism effect on the maintenance page.
  • Fully responsive and lightweight (No performance lag).

License

This plugin is licensed under the GPLv2 or later.
sections.installation:
1. Go to Plugins > Add New in your WordPress dashboard.
  2. Search for Lite Maintenance Mode.
  3. Install and activate the plugin.
  4. Go to the new Maintenance menu in your admin dashboard to configure your page.
sections.faq:
Who can see the site when maintenance mode is on?

Only administrators with manage_options capability can see the live site. All other roles and guests will see the maintenance page.

Will it affect my site’s SEO?

No. The plugin informs search engines that the downtime is temporary using 503 Service Unavailable and Retry-After headers.

How do I add Social Media links?

Navigate to the Social Profile tab in the plugin settings and enter your URLs.

Can I use a custom Favicon?

Yes! Under the Logo & Background tab, you can upload a specific icon for the maintenance page.
sections.changelog:
1.0.3

  • NEW: Completely redesigned Admin UI based on Figma designs for a better user experience.
  • NEW: Added Social Media profile options (Facebook, Instagram, WhatsApp, Twitter).
  • NEW: Added Favicon upload support for the maintenance page.
  • FIX: Improved tab switching logic using localStorage to prevent redirecting to the dashboard tab after saving changes.
  • FIX: Added cache-busting for Favicons to ensure immediate updates.
  • IMPROVEMENT: Added copyright footer section on the maintenance page.

1.0.2

  • FIX: Refactored code to use standard WordPress functions.
  • FIX: Removed inline CSS to comply with WordPress.org guidelines.

1.0.1

  • Initial release.
